title: Correct tension magnitude
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be F_T = kq²/l².

title: Correct kinetic energy
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be E_k = kq²/l.

title: Correct system momentum
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must state the system's total momentum is zero.

title: Correct final kinetic energy
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be E_k' = 3kq²/(2l).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must equate the Coulomb repulsion between two spheres to the string tension.

title: Centripetal force setup
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly set up Newton's second law for circular motion, accounting for net radial forces on a sphere.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy (kinetic + electrostatic potential) after the strings are cut.

title: Momentum conservation reasoning
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must recognize that the system's total momentum remains zero due to symmetry and no external horizontal forces.

title: Incorrect radius or geometry
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect radius for the circular motion (e.g., l instead of l/(2cos30°)) or misidentifying force directions.

title: Sign or factor error
description: Pitfall: Making sign errors in force components or algebraic mistakes in solving simultaneous equations.
